title: Deliciu Raspberry Key Lime 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid 20mg By Vaporesso

This Nic Salt e-liquid delivers a vibrant and refreshing vaping experience, ideal for those who enjoy a sharp, flavourful hit with each vape. The tartness of the raspberry seamlessly complements the zesty kick of key lime, creating a unique taste that's both invigorating and immensely satisfying. This vape juice’s 50VG/50PG mix provides a smooth and flavoursome vape with ample cloud production, while the nicotine salt formulation ensures a satisfying nicotine hit with a gentle throat sensation, making it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod vape devices. All Deliciu e-liquids contain less sweeteners than similar liquids which is kinder to your coil and results in a more authentic, nuanced flavour. Nicotine salts are designed for rapid absorption into the bloodstream, providing faster relief from nicotine cravings over traditional freebase e-liquids. This makes Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice a great choice for ex-smokers and those who appreciate an immediate nicotine satisfaction without the harshness of higher-strength e-liquids. Deliciu e-liquids are an exciting new line of vape juices developed by one of the most innovative and successful vape hardware brands in the world: Vaporesso. With their fine understanding of the way e-liquid interacts with their many celebrated vape devices, Deliciu have created an exceptional line-up of e-liquid flavours that include bold new inventions alongside many classic flavour profiles.
